run_ultralytics_video_tracking: run video object detection and tracking with YOLO and ByteTrack annotating bounding boxes and labels
create_byte_track_tracker: create a ByteTrack tracker instance for multi-object video tracking with supervision
create_box_annotator: create a BoxAnnotator to draw bounding boxes around detected objects on video frames
create_label_annotator: create a LabelAnnotator to display detection labels alongside bounding boxes on annotated frames
create_video_sink: create a VideoSink to write annotated video frames to an output file with video metadata
